CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of General Epistle: James? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say General Epistle: James has no place in daily life.
   C. Use General Epistle: James to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Epistle: James.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King David? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King David with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Monarchy in Israel: King David.
   C. Say Monarchy in Israel: King David has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Monarchy in Israel: King David to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

5. Which response best shows understanding of Schism and Syncretism in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Schism and Syncretism in Israel.
   B. Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Schism and Syncretism in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Schism and Syncretism in Israel has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings? (1 mark)
   A. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings has no place in daily life.
   B. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Bible Study Methods Devotional Method has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Bible Study Methods Devotional Method to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Study Methods Devotional Method.

10. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o? (1 mark)
   A. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o has no place in daily life.
   B. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Use Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon.
   C. Say Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Modern medicine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Study Methods Devotional Method and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Biblical Stewardship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Monarchy in Israel: King David and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
